holder.description: DID of the credential's subject/holder (becomes credentialSubject.id).

claims.description: The scoped claims to attest — the share's scope. Opaque to the framework; non-empty.

credentialType.description: Additional credential type beyond VerifiableCredential (e.g. ScopedShareCredential).

validitySeconds.description: Credential lifetime in seconds from issuance. The issuer MAY cap this.

purpose.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded for audit.

Response.title: VTA Credentials Issue — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/credentials/issue request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/credentials/issue/0.1#response.

credentialId.description: Stable identifier for the issued credential — the handle for revocation and audit.

expiresAt.description: When the credential's validUntil falls due.

credential.description: The issued Verifiable Credential (W3C VC Data Model 2.0), signed by the issuing context's key.
